content.purpose: Creates a complete Power Apps Code App starter project with PAC CLI setup, Power Apps SDK wiring, and connector-ready configuration.
content.whenToUse: Use this when you need a code-first Power Apps web app scaffolded with Vite, React, TypeScript, and Power Platform integration.
content.outputs: Provides the project structure, core configuration files, development scripts, a sample connector-based implementation, and setup documentation.
